explanation:
[EFFECT] Higher temperatures (red dots) are associated with contributions near zero to slightly positive, while lower temperatures (blue dots) pull predicted demand down substantially, reaching around −1.5 in log space. The relationship is roughly monotonic: warmer = more riders.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the second most important feature, with a large horizontal spread second only to hour of day.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability and staffing — primarily on the hour of day and temperature, as these two features drive the vast majority of demand variation; ensure full availability during warm-weather daytime hours and scale back overnight and in cold conditions.
